name: Meet Again: Heartwell
source:
You and your sister visit the isolated island of Heartwell for spring break to dog-sit for your mother. 

There, you meet Marsh and Jade, fraternal twins whose relationship is strained in ways they refuse to talk about. Marsh is guarded and withdrawn. Jade is warm and playful. Getting to know them reveals how different they are and how far apart they’ve grown.

As you spend time on the island, something begins to feel off. You experience headaches, dizzy spells, and an unsettling ability to “read” others, hearing thoughts that feel too clear to be your own.

Years later, you return to Heartwell determined to reconnect, understand what pulled the twins apart, and uncover the truth behind the island that keeps slipping out of reach. 

[Edited from [url=https://alienpuppygames.itch.io/meet-again-heartwell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的妹妹在春假期间前往偏僻的哈特韦尔岛为你的母亲看护狗。

在那里，你遇到了马什和杰德，这对异卵双胞胎的关系因拒绝谈论而变得紧张。马什是守卫和退缩的。玉是温暖而俏皮的。了解他们就会发现他们有多么不同，以及他们之间的差距有多大。

当你在岛上度过一段时间时，你开始感觉有些不对劲。你会感到头痛、头晕，还有一种令人不安的“读懂”别人的能力，听到那些感觉太清晰而不是你自己的想法。

多年后，你回到心井，决心重新建立联系，了解是什么让双胞胎分开，并揭开这座不断滑落的岛屿背后的真相。

[编辑自[url=https://alienpuppygames.itch.io/meet-again-heartwell]itch.io[/url]]
